observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: indoor stage with polished wooden floor, colourful floor lighting, seated audience surrounding the dance floor on all sides, festival banner in the background
observation.dancers: one couple: one man and one woman
observation.formation_and_space: couple dancing together in open and closed embrace, moving across the center of the stage
observation.posture: upright torso, slight forward lean during rapid footwork, knees bent with bouncy weight distribution
observation.footwork: fast, rhythmic stepping with frequent kicks, toe taps, flicks, and syncopated footwork matching the beat
observation.arms_and_hands: arms relaxed and expressive, holding hands in open position, turning each other and raising arms above head
observation.hips_and_torso: torso relatively upright, hips moving naturally with the fast rhythm and bouncy steps

observation.levels_jumps_turns: bouncy steps at standing level, occasional turns and spins, final pose in a low lunge/dip
observation.costume_and_props: man wearing a dark suit jacket, trousers, white shirt, and tie; woman wearing a patterned sleeveless knee-length dress and low-heeled shoes

quick side-by-side kicks with arms extended holding hands
rapid synchronized stepping and kicking in open position
partner break-away where both dancers dance solo facing each other with high energy footwork
close embrace turns with bouncy knee drops and high kicks
